rows.Grade reason: Come and see, BLESS and the story work together; two approved prompts are long.
rows.Next improvement: Offer shorter 6.2/6.4 only when Dave assigns the wording pass; preserve approved text and IDs.

rows.Grade reason: Stop, Turn, Tell, Receive now has teach-it; the lesson remains long and lacks story art.
rows.Next improvement: Add lost-sheep artwork and trim repeated framing without weakening grace.

rows.Title: Loving God
rows.Grade reason: The Father story, robe sequence and explain-it question are strong; the older widget review is outstanding.
rows.Next improvement: Finish the Great Command widget review and Dave visual pass.

rows.Title: New Identity in Jesus
rows.Grade reason: The robe image and Great Exchange teach-back hold one clear idea; the older widget review remains.
rows.Next improvement: Finish the Great Exchange widget review, keeping identity and grace central.

rows.Title: The Guiding of the Holy Spirit
rows.Grade reason: GUIDE, the story, fitting tool and explain-it question meet the scored production checkpoints.
rows.Next improvement: Dave completes remaining visual/pilot gates; preserve his approved wording.

rows.Title: Growing Deep Roots in Jesus
rows.Grade reason: Roots before fruit and the root sequence are memorable; length and explicit transfer need attention.
rows.Next improvement: Lightly trim and propose one teach-it prompt tied to the roots.

rows.Title: Overview of the Bible
rows.Grade reason: Josiah and the library give a good Bible map; plain art, length, transfer and widget review remain.
rows.Next improvement: Prioritize story art and bookshelf review, then trim and propose a teach-it question.

rows.Title: Biblical Storyline
rows.Review notes: Other tools: The Bible Project: The Story of the Bible
rows.Grade reason: The four movements and two-minute retelling transfer well; repeat framing and older widget review remain.
rows.Next improvement: Trim repeated framing/extra resource material and finish the storyline widget review.

rows.Title: How to Study the Bible
rows.Grade reason: OIA includes real passage practice; five prompts and implicit transfer add discussion load.
rows.Next improvement: Propose a clearer teach-it step without losing the Psalm 23/John 10 exercise.

rows.Title: The Grace and Mercy Cycle
rows.Grade reason: Grace and mercy have a strong story and cycle; diagram review and explicit teach-it are unfinished.
rows.Next improvement: Finish diagram review and propose an explain-it question without changing theology on Dave's behalf.

rows.Title: Living the Fruit of the Spirit
rows.Grade reason: Abiding and fruit are strong; the older widget, long prompt and missing teach-it hold the package back.
rows.Next improvement: Review the fruit widget and propose a shorter prompt plus teach-it; keep the Spirit's work central.

rows.Title: Repentance and the Learning Circle
rows.Grade reason: The Learning Circle has valuable depth; story placement, repeated setup, transfer and widget review remain.
rows.Next improvement: Preserve Dave's requested challenge and depth. Smooth repeated explanation, review the widget and propose teach-it.

rows.Title: Loving Your Neighbors
rows.Grade reason: The new Samaritan sequence strengthens Cross the Road; length, a long prompt and transfer still need work.
rows.Next improvement: Trim stacked setup and propose a concrete teach-it step. Preserve Grok's integrated sequence.

rows.Title: Loving Your Family at Home - Your First Neighbors
rows.Widget / exercise: Five Stones of a Life of Faith
rows.Grade reason: Three Rs, family roles, teach-it and sequence meet the production checkpoints.
rows.Next improvement: Dave reviews the latest rain/timing treatment; preserve the approved lesson wording.

rows.Grade reason: Early-church art and family teaching fit; the discussion stays with personal need rather than teach-it.
rows.Next improvement: Propose a church-family explain-it question and make formal definition language plainer.

rows.Grade reason: Farmers, APEST, the tool and teach-it form a focused, reproducible package.
rows.Next improvement: Dave completes remaining widget/art/pilot gates; no required scored production gap.

rows.Title: Suffering

rows.Next improvement: Review discussion pacing and final visuals; keep 6.2's existing explain-it question.

rows.Title: Marriage and Relationships
rows.Grade reason: Covenant/chisel teaching and the triangle are strong; an explicit teach-it prompt is missing.
rows.Next improvement: Propose a teach-it question for Dave; preserve his approved covenant wording.

rows.Title: Fighting for Purity

rows.Next improvement: Propose shorter 9.1/9.2 plus teach-it, without replacing Dave's wording before approval.

rows.Title: Baptism and the Lord's Supper
rows.Grade reason: Doorway and table make baptism and communion memorable; the observer question gives only implicit transfer.
rows.Next improvement: Propose what the learner would explain to the observer in 10.4.

rows.Title: The Great Commission - Your Personal Ministry
rows.Review notes: Current image is a logo, not story artwork.
rows.Grade reason: The ministry map gives a useful starting point; the only image is a logo and teach-it is missing.
rows.Next improvement: Add mountain story art and propose a teach-it question tied to the map.

rows.Title: BLESS - Begin in Prayer
rows.Review notes: Current image is a logo, not story artwork.; Other tools: Build Your Daily Prayers
rows.Grade reason: Their life, their heart, my part supports practical prayer; logo-only art and length remain.
rows.Next improvement: Add Nehemiah story art, trim repetition and make the prayer-card step self-contained.

rows.Title: BLESS - Listen and Eat - Show Hospitality
rows.Grade reason: The Emmaus sequence now completes the listening/table package with concrete hospitality transfer.
rows.Next improvement: Dave reviews the new sequence; make the prayer-card reference self-contained as optional polish.

rows.Title: BLESS - Serve with Loving Sacrifice
rows.Grade reason: Jesus with the towel, serving and teach-it work well; two approved prompts are long.
rows.Next improvement: Propose shorter 4.2/4.3 while retaining Dave's meaning. No new widget is required.

rows.Title: BLESS - Share Your Story and the Gospel
rows.Grade reason: The testimony and draw-it invitation transfer strongly; length and the older widget review remain.
rows.Next improvement: Trim repeated bridge/faithfulness setup and finish the Three Circles widget review.

rows.Title: Faith at Work and School - Your Second Space
rows.Grade reason: Daniel, faithful work and three spaces are clear; praying for a name gives only implicit transfer.
rows.Next improvement: Propose an explicit pass-it-on step while preserving approved wording and age clarification.

rows.Next improvement: Retain Dave's original sketch; consider a separately approved reveal treatment only if he wants one.

rows.Review notes: Dave accepted a longer lesson and retained his mid-lesson questions; full lesson approval remains unrecorded.; Paul/Timothy currently has a static B&W image; color treatment not approved.
rows.Grade reason: SPACES is the strongest multiplication model; long prompts and a static Paul/Timothy image remain.
rows.Next improvement: Keep Dave's accepted longer lesson and depth. Propose question polish and complete only approved art treatment.

rows.Title: Church Planting - Missions - Ministry Partners
rows.Review notes: Text differs from September approval in recap and one story sentence; questions still match.
rows.Grade reason: Tentmaker artwork now supports the mission map; the mission-choice questions leave transfer implicit.
rows.Next improvement: Propose explicit teach-it and recheck the later recap/story wording against the earlier approval.

rows.Review notes: No lesson image present; N/A is not an approved visual gate.
